scripts.//test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not tuning: both suites shell out to `dart run`, which shares .dart_tool state, and concurrent files intermittently fail one of the Dart invocations.
scripts.//smoke:mcp: Drives the DEPLOYED /mcp endpoint over the network, so it is not part of `npm test`. Run after a functions deploy, or pass another origin: `npm run smoke:mcp -- https://host/mcp`.
